layout: The mathematical notes are treated as the author’s working hand; attribution of the isolated pagination is indeterminate. Main column begins with numbered system (2), followed by the rho path explanation, two three-row conjugation systems, a prose cancellation with local replacements and deletions, a dotted presentation, a final rho-cube display and two prose lines. A dense right-margin NB note has trials, an arrow, a vertical separator and action formulas. Two lower slanted notes occupy the space beneath the dotted cube and the lower-left corner. Handwritten 17 is at lower right; no source header number is present. Line count treats separate replacement inscriptions, marginal baselines, display rows and the footer as read units.

changes.place: Upper display (2), three overwritten right members
changes.ink: Three old products are physically cancelled. The first two are blackened and remain doubtful; the third has a readable looped l, two-lobed infinity and descending rho. The new rho precedes each l; the first replacement is below, the other two above. H relegates the old inscriptions to an editorial note.
changes.math_consequence: Records the change in multiplication order without recovering obscured old indices as certain.

changes.place: Right margin, three cancelled trial rows and a side trial
changes.ink: Ces begins with a low open c, not a tall l; the left-pointing arrow and three points after the conjugation example are distinct. Raised2 exponents remain visible after the first two parenthesized trial factors, contrary to their omission in the blind reading. The crowded first trial’s final parenthesis admits both recorded factor sequences. Beside the second live equality, the crossed inscription has a large closed O, low n and separate a, matching the live On a immediately below; it is not sigma-infinity. In the second cancelled action trial, the final low index has two joined rounded traces, favouring infinity over0, but the hatch crosses it. The tall left boundary is a real independent rule and stops near the second live action. All three replacement action formulas are clear and unstruck.

changes.place: Lower local cancellation, word before the comma

changes.place: Lower local cancellation, ou and the unfinished sigma equality

changes.place: Lower main text, live et sigma above/right of the unfinished equality

changes.place: Dotted presentation, first squared sigma index

changes.place: Small slanted margin below the dotted-rho cube
changes.ink: The first line starts with a large C and compressed connected strokes compatible with Comme on voit. The middle line has three separated groups: the first permits ils or être, the middle has two low humps permitting en/un, and the last permits sont/des. The last line has pas with a distinct underline, followed by crowded letters admitting conjugués or exigée. A separate-looking short terminal horizontal stroke supports an underline below the last syllable, but its independence from the writing remains uncertain and is retained as an alternative. The nearby dotted-rho cube belongs to the main display, not this prose.

changes.place: Continuation after the dotted presentation, le système

changes.place: Continuation after references (1)(2), enfin
changes.ink: After et, a low rounded opening and joined course lead to a tall stroke and short final r/e-like turn. There is no independently clear f descender or i dot establishing enfin.
